metadata.note: Canonical list of REAL Ho Chi Minh City establishments, generated by scripts/import-restaurants.ts from data/source/hcmc-restaurants.source.json. Every record cites its sources; lastVerified is the date of the desk check. Demonstration venues live in data/samples/ and are never mixed in here.
metadata.coverage: Ho Chi Minh City administrative boundary as of 1 July 2025 (former HCMC, Bình Dương and Bà Rịa – Vũng Tàu). Enforced by the importer and `npm run data:validate`.
